title: MULTIPLAYER RACING GAME? | COPICafe Episode 42 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode of COPI Cafe, Rob and Josh give a huge update relating to Multiplayer Racing, which has been successfully tested internally across multiple countries. They then move on to talk about the vision for Cornucopias and how Cornucopias will evolve over time. Josh then explains that they have taken on a full time animator who has been working on the locomotion for game characters. The guys then go on to answer some community questions and then move on to invite a special guest, Late Game Crypto! Finally, we move on over to share some exciting new vehicle leaks! 

Late Game Crypto's channel: https://www.youtube.com/@LateGameCrypto

00:00 Beverage Choices
01:35 Team Update
06:06 The Vision
11:47 New Animator!
13:00 Community Questions
16:19 Lategamecrypto! 
28:11 Leak!

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
